Hi Maya 10,

Thanks for catching that 1 good eyes. The overlap is intentional 1 we run a "slot baton" for tight virtual loops so candidates don't have long gaps and interviewers can brief each other quickly. Practical notes below so you know exactly what to expect:

- Panel 1 (Design): 11:0011:25 in Zoom A. Please join Zoom A at 11:00 and stay through the end of the scheduled time.
- Panel 2 (Platform): 11:1811:50 in Zoom B. Platform will begin a short handoff at 11:18 so you can move to Zoom B around that time.

We aim for a 7-minute overlap: final 4 minutes of Panel 1 are an explicit verbal handoff (23 bullet recap + outstanding questions), then the first 3 minutes of Panel 2 are a quick context sync before technical questions.

Debrief owners: Laura Bennett will scribe and own the Design panel notes; Karthik Iyer is collecting Platform notes and will consolidate final feedback and post to the HubSpot deal. I'll circulate the mutual action plan after EOD.

Attaching the candidate packet and the loop agenda for convenience. If you'd prefer fully non-overlapping slots, I can move Platform to a later time 1 tell me and I'll update invites.

See you at 11:00!
